draw: (ctx, i, p, env) => { const ink = env.palette.ink, acc = env.palette.accent; const u = 70, bh = 84, x0 = 60, base = 372; const B = [[0,0,4,'#8a5a2b',0,0],[1,0,4,'#c8202a',1,0],[2,0,2,'#7a1f1f',2,0],[2,2,2,'#d9c08c',2,1],[3,1,2,'#9bd53a',3,0],[3,3,1,'#c8202a',4,0]]; const ease = env.ease.out; ctx.lineJoin = 'round'; for (const b of B) { const [c, sx, w, col, s, k] = b; if (s > i) continue; let off = 0, alpha = 1, cur = s === i; if (cur) { const n = B.filter(q => q[4] === i).length; const a = n > 1 ? k / n : 0, e = n > 1 ? (k + 1) / n : 1; const q = ease(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (p - a) / (e - a)))); if (q <= 0) continue; off = -(1 - q) * 60; alpha = q; } ctx.globalAlpha = cur ? alpha : 0.35; const round = b === B[5]; const x = x0 + sx * u + (round ? 6 : 0), ww = w * u - (round ? 12 : 0), y = base - (c + 1) * bh + off; const studs = []; for (let j = 0; j < w; j++) studs.push([x0 + (sx + j) * u + u * 0.2, y - 14, u * 0.6, 14]); if (cur) { ctx.strokeStyle = acc; ctx.lineWidth = 10; ctx.strokeRect(x, y, ww, bh); for (const st of studs) ctx.strokeRect(st[0], st[1], st[2], st[3]); } ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fillRect(x, y, ww, bh); for (const st of studs) ctx.fillRect(st[0], st[1], st[2], st[3]); ctx.strokeStyle = ink; ctx.lineWidth = cur ? 3 : 2; ctx.strokeRect(x, y, ww, bh); for (const st of studs) ctx.strokeRect(st[0], st[1], st[2], st[3]); if (b === B[3]) { ctx.lineWidth = 2; for (let g = 1; g < 4; g++) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + 10, y + g * bh / 4); ctx.lineTo(x + ww - 10, y + g * bh / 4); ctx.stroke(); } } } ctx.globalAlpha = 1; ctx.fillStyle = ink; ctx.font = `600 18px "${env.font}"`; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'alphabetic'; for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) ctx.fillText(String(j + 1), x0 + j * u + u / 2, 394); ctx.strokeStyle = ink; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0 - 20, base); ctx.lineTo(x0 + 4 * u + 20, base); ctx.stroke(); }
